new_value: Already implemented: R1 Neo DTS has battery0 alias (line 56), vbatt voltage-divider node (lines 60-66), and ADC channel@7 (lines 104-111). Board configs enable CONFIG_SENSOR=y and CONFIG_LICHEN_HAS_BATTERY=y. HAL read_voltage_divider_battery() provides battery_voltage_mv. battery_percent is N/A for voltage-dividers (requires fuel gauge). Verified in lichen/boards/muzi/r1_neo/r1_neo_nrf52840.dts and lichen/apps/*/boards/r1_neo_nrf52840.conf.
